title: Sam Barlow and Brandon Cronenberg present Precognition, a sci-fi horror game
summary: The creator of Immortality collaborates with the filmmaker on a title that lets players see and change the future; it will arrive in 2028.

title: CD Projekt lays off more than 20% of the Project Sirius team, The Witcher multiplayer
summary: The project suffers a second wave of layoffs as part of a change in development strategy.

title: Amazon abandons operation of Lost Ark and Throne and Liberty and hands control to their developers
summary: The company leaves the MMO business in the West; Smilegate and NC will take over the servers.

title: Saber Interactive denies replacing Rideshare Stimulator's lead writer with AI
summary: The company acknowledges the use of generative writing in the game, but denies that the writer was dismissed because of ChatGPT.

title: Aspyr re-releases The Lord of the Rings: War in the North and announces more reissues of the saga
summary: The remaster of the cooperative game is just the first of several classic Tolkien titles the company plans to bring back.

title: Ghost of Yōtei receives a narrative expansion, a roguelike mode, and a complete edition on October 1
summary: Sucker Punch expands the game with new story missions and a wave-based survival mode alongside the Complete Edition.

title: Helldivers 2 joins the PlayStation Plus Extra and Premium catalog in August 2026
summary: Sony confirms that the co-op shooter is now available for subscribers of the paid service.

title: Warhammer 40,000: Dawn of War 4 delays its launch until December 3
summary: The studio says the delay will allow it to polish the experience and deliver the expected quality before release.

title: The 'Devoid of Liberty' update for Helldivers 2 lets players hug soldiers and adds new enemies
summary: The patch refreshes SEAF troops, introduces hugs, and adds new alien threats inspired by horror.

title: Crimson Desert will come to Switch 2 and will have DLC this year; Pearl Abyss reports a drop in revenue
summary: The action RPG broadens its offering with additional content and a new platform during a quarter of adjustment following its launch.

title: Phantom Blade Zero announces State of Play, digital pre-orders, and Donnie Yen collaboration
summary: S-Game reveals new details about the game, including the stunts supervised by the actor and the uncertainties about its physical edition.

title: Bethesda promises to bring the Oblivion Remastered optimizations for Switch 2 to other platforms
summary: Following the criticism and the Switch 2 patch, the company says it will apply performance improvements to the rest of the systems.

title: A giant inflatable rat interrupts The Elder Scrolls 6 demo as a union protest
summary: Bethesda's internal event, with Xbox's CEO in attendance, was used by employees to criticize the cutbacks.

title: Take-Two CEO weighs in on console price hike and GTA 6 pre-orders
summary: The executive avoids giving pre-order figures and considers the hardware price increase negative, although he trusts Rockstar.

title: Twitch trains Amazon AI models with streamers' content by default
summary: The platform activates data collection for AI without explicit consent and hides the opt-out option.

title: Xbox says it has fixed the bug that worsened the July server outage
summary: The company attributes the outage, which left even disc-based games unusable, to a bug that has already been fixed.

title: Christopher Judge, Kratos actor, criticizes adaptations for ignoring video game creators
summary: The God of War actor calls for television series to include the original developers of the games.

title: Crescent County, an adventure inspired by Kiki's Delivery Service and Akira, will arrive in summer 2027
summary: The magical delivery game will be released on PS5, Xbox Series, Switch 2, and PC.

title: The free 'Black Hole' update for Bubsy 4D adds 15 levels and new costumes
summary: The new content is already available and includes additional levels, outfits, and more improvements for the game.
